$comment: Release manifest for moving OPC Foundation review drafts from marcschier/opcua-drafts to OPCF-Members/spec-drafts. Dependency closure is derived from RequiredModel declarations, validator/tool path reads, cross-tree markdown links, aggregate validators, and Word clause-map sources. Avro tooling maps cloud-specs/observability-export/Opc.Ua.ObservabilityExport.NodeSet2.xml as a sample base model; observability-export is listed with submitted false so it can be vendored into private exports while remaining public. A submitted spec moves its committed Word rendering and the figures its clause map declares, because Word is the review format and the .docx is the artifact under review; vendored specs do not, because they are not reviewed.

avro-encoding.$comment: Releasable. Tooling imports shared _common and validate_local.py invokes build_schemas.py with no arguments, so the default Observability Export NodeSet is a private-side runtime dependency. Observability Export is vendored, not closed over: it is copied to the private export but remains public.
avro-encoding.title: OPC UA — Apache Avro DataEncoding

observability-export.$comment: Shared sample/base NodeSet for the Avro (and Arrow) schema generators, not an independently releasable OPC Foundation review submission. Only the NodeSet is vendored, because that is the single file Avro's build_schemas.py opens and nothing that moves reads the prose. Vendoring the folder instead copied documents whose relative links pointed at examples that were never exported, so the private repository failed its own link check on arrival.
observability-export.title: OPC UA — Observability Export

openusd-binding.$comment: Releasable OpenUSD Part 1. xRegistry is vendored, not closed over: the private export needs the base NodeSet/CSV and word spec so RequiredModel and validators resolve, but xRegistry stays public because it is a shared base for other public specs and has a public xregistry.org proposal. The xregistry.org OpenUSD domain document/model stay public. metaverse-specs/extras/openusd-artifacts is split at file granularity: build_catalog.py, validate_local.py, examples, schemas and README move because they read private Part 1 example descriptors, while tools/validate_spec.py stays public because it validates only the kept xregistry.org domain document/model.
openusd-binding.title: OPC UA for OpenUSD — Part 1: OpenUSD Binding

openusd-scene.$comment: Releasable OpenUSD Part 2. Its NodeSet is self-contained on base OPC UA, but its example regeneration and round-trip tooling read Part 1 example USDA assets, so Part 1 is in the release closure.
openusd-scene.title: OPC UA for OpenUSD — Part 2: Scene Materialization

wot-binding.$comment: Releasable WoT vocabulary/binding specification. It has no NodeSet RequiredModel and its validator is local to wot-specs/WoT-Binding. wot-specs/extras/WoT-Binding holds the informative crosswalk that supports this draft and links into it, so it travels with the specification like every other extras mirror.
wot-binding.title: OPC UA — Web of Things Binding

wot-connectivity.$comment: Releasable WoT Connectivity revision. WoT Binding is in closure because it is part of the OPC Foundation WoT submission. xRegistry is vendored, not closed over: the private export needs the base NodeSet/CSV and word spec so RequiredModel and validators resolve, but xRegistry stays public because it is a shared base for other public specs and has a public xregistry.org proposal.
wot-connectivity.title: OPC UA — WoT Connectivity

xregistry.$comment: Shared base model, not an independently releasable OPC Foundation submission. It stays public because Schema Registry and other public specs subtype it and xRegistry-OPC-UA-Api.md targets xregistry.org. Vendored as a closed set: the two generated artifacts so a released NodeSet's RequiredModel on http://opcfoundation.org/UA/xRegistry/ resolves, plus the two specification documents, which released documents link to and which link only to each other and to external URLs. README.md is deliberately excluded because it links onward to Schema Registry and WoT Connectivity, which stay public, and vendoring it would drag an unbounded set of public prose into the private repository.
xregistry.title: OPC UA — xRegistry
